title: UFO
body:
"👽Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr"

Description

The UFO was a vehicle obtained during the Martian Invasion event, unboxed it is a small drivable vehicle that floats a couple studs in the air, when driving it has a top speed of around 81 studs/s. you cannot store anything in the UFO.

Tips and Trivia

  • Given the UFOS ability to float and its speed and is good at traversing the world with ease
  • The UFO does NOT float in water, lava, acid or void water and will sink like all other vehicles
